T-001.Title: Restore fitted-wide table viewer access and align browser contracts with accepted no-scroll, icon-only table behavior.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Wide/tall tables retain need-gated viewer access, natural-size pan and export; small tables remain hidden and untabbable. Accepted no internal scroll, icon-only controls and editable cells remain intact. Real pointer context menus and last-column resizing retain substantive assertions. Conditional clone/interaction edits require a demonstrated defect; no toolbar/editor/native changes, test skips, lowered floors or timeout changes.
